hooks.command: echo "[engineering-insights] Before working: identify the module(s) this task touches or discusses (server, client, reviewer-core, e2e) and Read their Insights.md, then state in one line which entries apply (or 'No recorded insights apply')."

hooks.prompt:
You decide whether Claude must record engineering insights before stopping. Hook input JSON: $ARGUMENTS

Rules:
1. If stop_hook_active is true, respond {"ok": true}.
2. Read last_assistant_message. Respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Run the engineering-insights skill: <one-line description of the insight>"} ONLY if it reveals a SUBSTANTIAL, evidenced engineering insight in this repo (server, client, reviewer-core, e2e) in one of these categories: an idea to clarify or improve something, a potential problem, or a contradiction (code vs docs, docs vs docs, code vs tests, spec vs implementation) - AND the message does not say it was already recorded in an Insights.md.
3. Otherwise (routine work, no new insight, insight already recorded, pure conversation) respond {"ok": true}.
When in doubt, respond {"ok": true}. Respond with JSON only.
